reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch overlaps with another series by Kairui, which cleans up __folio_split(), and requested further investigation to determine the best course of action.
reviews.raw_body:
Kairui has a series that cleans up __folio_split()[1]. It seems that your
patch 3, 4, and 5 overlap with his changes (e.g., your patch 3 is the
same as his patch 3).


[1] https://lore.kernel.org/all/20260821-swap-thp-cleanup-v3-0-9b43f5163238@tencent.com/

-- 
Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch reduces the indentation level in the __folio_freeze_and_split_unmapped() function by short-circuiting it if folio_ref_freeze() fails, thus saving an indent level for the whole function. The change is a trivial cleanup and does not introduce any functional changes to the code. It modifies the huge_memory.c file by removing unnecessary indentation and simplifying the function's logic.
